idx_titulo: DM Atelier, 3D-printed nail drill bit demo kit by Dayse Marques
idx_desc: Giant drill bits, stand, finger and nails for nail training, designed by nail educator Dayse Marques, 3D-printed to order and engraved with your salon's name.
hero_h1: Giant drill bits for training, engraved with your salon's name
hero_chapo: The kit from my training table, made for yours. I'm Dayse Marques, nail technician and educator. With these oversized bits, my students see the shape and grit of every drill bit. Every kit is 3D-printed to order, in Belgium.
col_p: Everything you need to show the technique on the training table or in your salon window.
col_alt: The six giant drill bits on their DM-engraved stand, in front of two demo fingers with red nails.
col_li1: 6 giant drill bits, from the barrel to the cone cutter
col_li2: 1 stand for the bits, engraved with your salon's name
etapas_p: No account needed. Ordering takes a few messages.
e1_p: Choose the name to engrave and the ring colour on the kit page.
e2_p: The button writes the message with your choices. All you do is send it.
e3_p: We confirm the price, shipping and lead time, then send you a payment link for card, Bancontact or iDEAL.
e4_p: Your kit is printed after payment and shipped to Belgium, France, the Netherlands, Luxembourg, Germany or Austria.
msg_aria: Example of the message the site prepares
msg_exemplo:
Hello DM Atelier! I would like to order:
Nail drill bit demo kit
Engraving: "Studio Léa"
Rings: red
Could you tell me the price and lead time?
dayse_aria: DM monogram, the one engraved on the pieces
dayse_h2: Why a nail educator designs her own tools
dayse_p1: A drill bit is only a few millimetres long. In a training session, the student sitting opposite can't see the grit or the angle. Oversized, the whole table sees the shape before the drill is switched on.
dayse_p2: I use this kit first in my own training sessions in Chapelle-lez-Herlaimont. The finger and nails let me show the movement, and the stand keeps every bit in its place on the workstation.
dayse_assinatura: Dayse Marques, nail technician and educator
faq1_r: Every kit is printed to order, after payment. We give you the production time on WhatsApp before payment.
faq2_q: Where do you ship and how much does it cost?
faq2_r: We ship to Belgium, France, the Netherlands, Luxembourg, Germany and Austria. Shipping depends on the country and the weight. We give you the price on WhatsApp before payment.
faq3_r: Once your order is confirmed, you receive a secure payment link: bank card, Bancontact or iDEAL. Printing starts after payment.
faq4_r: A kit engraved with your salon's name is made for you and can't be returned, unless it is faulty. A kit without a salon name can be returned within 14 days of delivery.
faq5_q: Can the bits be used in a nail drill?
faq5_r: No. They are oversized models in 3D-printed plastic, made for showing and display.

c_lit: Belgian law applies. In case of disagreement, you can contact the Belgian Consumer Ombudsman Service (consumerombudsman.be).
p_1: The site sets no cookies. Visits are measured with GoatCounter, without cookies and without data that identifies you.
p_2: When you order, we receive your name, your number, your delivery address and the text to engrave on WhatsApp. This data is used only to make, deliver and invoice your order. Invoices are kept for 7 years, as the law requires.
p_3: WhatsApp is a Meta service with its own privacy policy. Payment is handled by the provider of the payment link.
p_4: You can ask on WhatsApp to access, correct or delete your data. You can also file a complaint with the Belgian Data Protection Authority (dataprotectionauthority.be).
